items.claim: Sergey Spivak showed heart and weathered an early storm in his win against Tybura.
items.quote: he showed heart and he like weathered an early storm.

items.claim: Chanel Dyer is better everywhere and will outstrike Ellis Reed.
items.quote: I do think Chanel Dyer is better everywhere. It's probably going to be a striking match primarily and I think Chanel Dyer is going to outstrike her.

items.claim: Jackson McVey uses his kickboxing a bit better than Wes Schultz.
items.quote: I do like the way McVy uses his kickboxing a bit better.
